anomalies.expected: The specification states 'Reset line: R10 (10 kΩ) ties NRST to VCC, holding the MCU's NRST pin high at idle', so a 10 k pull-up to VCC must be present on the NRST net.

evidence.quote: Reset line: R10 (10 kΩ) ties NRST to VCC, holding the MCU's NRST pin high at idle; NRST is also wired to J1 pin 3 (~RESET) so the Tag-Connect programmer can pull it low.
Root sheet (PCB.kicad_sch): U2 pin 7 'NRST' wired to label 'NRST' and to C19 1u to GND; no pull-up resistor on this node.

anomalies.impact: With no external pull-up the NRST pin is left floating (only a 1 u filter cap to GND). Power-on reset state is undefined and the MCU may fail to boot reliably or latch into reset.

anomalies.observed: The programming header J1's reset pin carries a global label 'RESET', whereas the MCU reset pin U2.7 carries the global label 'NRST'. The two labels have different names and no wire joins them, so the header reset pin is not connected to the MCU reset pin.
anomalies.expected: Per the specification the MCU NRST net is 'also wired to J1 pin 3 (~RESET) so the Tag-Connect programmer can pull it low', i.e. both pins must share one net.

evidence.quote: NRST is also wired to J1 pin 3 (~RESET) so the Tag-Connect programmer can pull it low.
Root sheet 'Programming (SWD)' block: J1 reset pin labelled 'RESET'; MCU U2 pin 7 labelled 'NRST' - no common net.

anomalies.impact: The SWD programmer cannot assert MCU reset, so 'connect under reset' programming/debugging fails and the board cannot be reliably flashed or debugged over the Tag-Connect header.

parsed.summary: The NFC, display, touch, decoupling and SWD-signal sections match the specification, but the reset network deviates: the specified 10 k NRST pull-up R10 is absent (NRST has only a 1 u cap to GND) and the header's reset pin uses a mismatched net label ('RESET' vs 'NRST'), leaving the MCU reset floating and disconnected from the programmer.
